faq.q: Can I make Black Friday ads for several products?
faq.a: Yes. Use a photo or link for each product and make a separate ad. Try different openings to see which offer gets attention.

faq.q: Can I make different sizes for each ad placement?
faq.a: Yes. Choose 9:16 for vertical feeds, 1:1 for square feeds, or 16:9 for wide placements. Other sizes include 4:3 and 3:4.

faq.q: Can I add music and product photos to a Black Friday ad?
faq.a: Yes. Use your product photo, choose music, and add your confirmed sale offer. You can make the ad without filming a new product video.

faq.q: Can a product link start a Black Friday ad?
faq.a: Yes. Paste your product link to bring in its photos and details. Add the sale offer, then check that the ad matches the product page.

faq.q: Can I start a Black Friday ad from my store listing?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product listing and use its photos to make a sale ad. Review the product details and discount before posting.

faq.q: When should I make my Black Friday ads?
faq.a: Make the product scenes early, then add the final discount, code, and end date once they are confirmed. Check every offer before posting.

faq.q: How much does a Black Friday ad cost?
faq.a: A photo costs 24 credits. Videos cost 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, or 120 for 30; failed jobs return credits.

faq.q: Can I add an end date to my sale ad?
faq.a: Yes. Add the confirmed end date and time to your message or captions. Check them before posting so customers see the right offer.

faq.q: Can I post Black Friday ads on TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook?
faq.a: Yes. Download the ad without a watermark and post it on TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook. Choose the size that fits each placement.

faq.q: Can I reuse the ad after Black Friday?
faq.a: Yes. Change the sale message, dates, and captions for your next promotion. You can reuse the product scene without another shoot.

faq.q: Can an AI actor announce my Black Friday sale?
faq.a: Yes. Choose an AI actor to speak your sale message beside the product. You do not need to hire a creator for each offer.
